Corollary
[precompactness under bounded Ricci and harmonic norm]

Source: petersen:page-0441 ↗ lem:pet-ch11-anderson-ricci-harmonic-c1alpha-bound ↗ thm:pet-ch11-fundamental-theorem-convergence 1. ch11:11.4.2With $n\ge 2$ and $Q,r,\Lambda \in (0,\infty )$, the class of Riemannian $n$-manifolds with $\| (M,g)\| ^{\mathrm{har}}_{C^{1,r}}\le Q$, $|\Ric |\le \Lambda $ is precompact in the pointed $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology for every $\alpha \in (0,1)$; the subclass of Einstein manifolds is compact in the $C^{m,\alpha }$ topology for every $m\ge 1$, $\alpha \in (0,1)$.
